name: Card
description: Composable contained surface for cards, modal bodies, drawers, popovers, toasts, and grouped content.

title.description: Convenience title slot rendered through Card.Title and Face UI Text.

description.description: Convenience description slot rendered through Card.Description and Face UI Text.

content.description: Convenience body slot rendered through Card.Content; primitive values use Face UI Text.

footer.description: Convenience footer slot: text, React content, component descriptors or arrays. The JSON editor accepts every serializable form.

variant.description: Meaningful surface role: standard contained surface, unframed composition, or code canvas.

padding.description: Internal surface inset, from the standard 7px rhythm down to a flush composition.

radius.description: Corner geometry for contained, compact, dialog, or flush surfaces.

border.description: Draw the surface border independently of padding, radius and variant.

hoverable.description: Highlight the surface on hover or focus within; does not create an action.

fullWidth.description: Stretch to the available inline size. False uses intrinsic width and preserves parent alignment.

footerAlign.description: Alignment used by the convenience footer slot. Compound usage configures Card.Footer directly.

children.description: Compound children or custom content escape hatch.

props.title: Card Title
props.content: Workspace settings and recent activity stay grouped in one place
Unframed content for composition inside another surface.

props.title: Deploy preview
props.content: The surface highlights on hover or focus within; its children own their actions.

notes: Card is the shared contained-surface shell for other composed components.
Card separates visual surface presets from behavior; Modal still owns dialog behavior and can render its body through Card.
Title, description, string content and footer strings render through Text; Button descriptors receive membranes by default.
The surface background is layered over an underlay token so transparency stays stable across parent backgrounds.

whenToUse: Shared contained surface for Modal, Popover, Toast, and gallery examples
whenNotToUse: Clickable list item by itself (use Button or Tile for interaction semantics)
Full-page layout container without a contained surface role
Dialog behavior by itself (use Modal; Modal may compose Card internally)
